ValidationRule.description: When Material Type is Quiz, Quiz Questions, Time Limit, and Passing Score are required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Material_Type__c, "Quiz"), OR( ISBLANK(Quiz_Questions__c), ISBLANK(Quiz_Time_Limit_Minutes__c), Quiz_Time_Limit_Minutes__c <= 0, ISBLANK(Passing_Score__c), Passing_Score__c < 0, Passing_Score__c > 100 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Quiz materials require: Quiz Questions (JSON), Time Limit > 0 minutes, and Passing Score between 0-100%.
